description:
Perform a Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) on the Big Five personality items. The dataset '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' contains 25 items measuring 5 factors (Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Neuroticism, Openness). 

1. Open the dataset in JASP.
2. Use the SEM module to specify a 5-factor model using lavaan syntax. Map the items to their respective factors (e.g., 'Neuroticism =~ N1 + N2 + N3 + N4 + N5').
3. Enable 'Model fit' indices (CFI, TLI, RMSEA, SRMR) and 'Standardized estimates' in the output options.
4. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/CFA_BigFive.jasp'.
5. Create a report file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/CFA_BigFive_Report.txt' containing the Model Chi-square, CFI, RMSEA, and SRMR values from your analysis.
